newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Danubius 's hotel buy officially cleared.
newsitem.headline: Danubius 's hotel buy officially cleared.

text.p: Hungary's Danubius Hotels Rt said on Thursday it had been officially notified by the Competition Office that its purchase of Hungaria Szalloda Rt hotel chain was cleared.

Under an agreement signed on September 30 with state privatisation agency APV Rt, Danubius will buy an 85 percent stake, worth a nominal 4.675 billion forints, in the hotel chain, for 8.125 billion forints.
Twenty percent of the purchase price is to be paid for by compensation coupons, Danubius said.
APV Rt approved the deal in August on condition that the Competition Office established that the total market share of the merged hotel chains did not exceed the maximum permitted 30 percent.
The price paid for the stake represents 173.8 percent of the face value of the shares.
The remaining 15 percent stake will be offered to employees with Danubius obliged to buy any shares not subscribed at the same rate of 173.8 percent of face value.
